title: When Evidence Shapes Collaboration: Knowledge-Conditioned Topology Generation for Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.27984v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) have recently moved from static workflows toward dynamically generated collaboration topologies. However, existing topology generation methods rely primarily on the parametric knowledge of large language models, with external search or retrieval used only as a reactive tool rather than an explicit determinant of collaboration structure. This leads to structure-knowledge misalignment, where systems exhibit redundant interactions or insufficient verification in knowledge-intensive tasks. We propose K-GAT (Knowledge-Guided Agent Topology Generator), a neuro-symbolic framework that formulates collaboration topology design as a knowledge-conditioned structure learning problem, integrating external evidence directly into autoregressive graph generation. translated_title: 当证据塑造协作：面向多智能体系统的知识条件化拓扑生成
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统（MAS）近来已从静态工作流转向动态生成的协作拓扑。然而，现有的拓扑生成方法主要依赖大语言模型的参数化知识，外部搜索或检索仅被用作被动响应的工具，而非协作结构的明确决定因素。这导致了结构与知识的不对齐，使系统在知识密集型任务中表现出冗余交互或验证不足的问题。我们提出了K-GAT（知识引导的智能体拓扑生成器），这是一个神经符号框架，将协作拓扑设计形式化为知识条件化的结构学习问题，将外部证据直接集成到自回归图生成过程中。在知识密集型基准测试上的大量实验证明了K-GAT的效率与有效性：特别是在专家级的GPQA数据集上，K-GAT超越了（原文此处截断）。
tldr: K-GAT提出了一种知识条件化的神经符号框架，将外部证据直接融入多智能体协作拓扑的自回归图生成过程，解决了结构-知识不对齐问题，在GPQA等知识密集型基准上表现出色。
en_tdlr: K-GAT proposes a neuro-symbolic framework that directly integrates external evidence into autoregressive graph generation for multi-agent collaboration topologies, resolving structure-knowledge misalignment and achieving strong performance on knowledge-intensive benchmarks like GPQA.
